market_summary: Market mood is bullish driven by two big forces: a Chinese buyer-led pump that sent Series 1 gloves +30-40% and dragged up knives/Doppler-tier items, plus a crypto crash (BTC sub-$60k) that historically rotates capital into CS2 skins. The dominant volatility driver, however, is the new souvenir-craft update that crashed collectible souvenir skins by 90-99% (R8 Bone Mask, AWP Asiimov/Viper, Glock Candy Apple, M4A1-S Nitro) — a structural supply shock making souvenir/sticker categories toxic. IEM Cologne Major (Spirit & FUT into Stage 3) supports team-sticker demand but no specific buy-tier sticker appears liquid in the data. Key risk: the knife Doppler 'swings' are largely thin-volume/illiquid wear-variant noise rather than genuine directional moves, so confidence is tempered outside high-volume names.
